name: Parallel Marching Cubes
definition: A parallel isosurface generation technique for huge datasets that do not fit entirely in memory, using a piecewise slice strategy along the k-direction where at least two slices fit into physical memory.
summary: Parallel Marching Cubes extracts isosurfaces from huge datasets by partitioning the grid into slices processed concurrently by multiple processes, solving memory bottlenecks of traditional methods.
